caption: The video captures a whitewater rapid running through a smooth granite-boulder gorge under a clear blue sky. A kayaker in a blue top sits in a bright yellow kayak, already working through the churning white water with the bow angled toward the lower left. Tiny spectator figures perch on the sunlit rocks at upper right in the wider views. The froth continuously splashes and sprays around the hull, at times nearly engulfing the paddler. The framing then tightens to a closer view of the rocks and water, and the sky and distant figures drop out of frame. In these tighter shots the kayaker holds the paddle raised across the body while the boat tilts and bobs in the turbulence. The granite boulders themselves remain stationary against the moving water. The paddler keeps working the turbulent channel, the yellow hull bobbing and turning amid the spray.
relations: Churning white water continuously splashes and sprays around the yellow kayak's hull, causing it to bob and tilt.
The smooth granite boulders remain stationary while the rapid's turbulent water flows forcefully past and around them.
The kayaker holds the paddle raised across the body while working through the turbulent channel amid the spray.
